name: Ore wa Jukujo Kyouai Shugi ~Yokkyuu Fuman na Hitozuma Hodo Ochiyasui~
original_name: 俺は熟女狂愛主義 ～欲求不満な人妻ほど堕ちやすい～
source:
Protagonist lost his parents when he was a child.
The protagonist lived his days in isolation, never experiencing the kindness of human beings. 
One day, he succumbed to heat stroke and fainted. Receiving kindness from that episode, he met Aika.
For the protagonist, who lived in solitude, she was like a goddess.
Before he realized, he fell in love with that person and started looking for her.
Finally coming across her, he found her having a loving husband.
Knowing this, the protagonist tried forcibly to make Aika his own...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=970659]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公小时候失去了双亲。
此后，他一直孤独生活，从未体验过人类的温柔。

一天，他因中暑昏倒。在那次事件中感受到他人的善意后，他遇见了爱花。
对于一直生活在孤独中的主人公而言，她就像女神。
不知不觉间，他爱上了她，开始寻找她。

终于再次遇见她时，他发现她已经有了一位深爱的丈夫。
得知这一点后，主人公试图强行将爱花据为己有……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=970659]Getchu[/url]]
